record.title: Second Saturday (November)
record.description: This month's theme is Seeds and Indigenous Heritage Month!

gamble.detailHtml:
This month’s theme is Seeds and Indigenous Heritage Month!

All ages are invited to spend a beautiful November morning at Gamble Garden.

FREE ACTIVITIES

  • Education Station:
    • Seed diversity station
    • Seed dissection station
    • Indigenous history and fun with acorns
    • Seed germination demonstration
  • Craft stations: seed bracelets, seed bombs, and coloring
  • Storytime led by Palo Alto City Librarian Heidi Von Mayr @ 10:30 & 11:15
  • Gamble Grown plant sale
  • A visit to Elizabeth’s house
  • Scavenger hunts
  • Guided tours at 10:00am, 10:30am, and 11:00am

Activities subject to change

COMMUNITY PARTNERS:

  • UC Master Gardeners – University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources shares science-based information and practices to improve lives and livelihoods. Extending UC’s world-class research beyond the system’s 10 campuses, Master Gardeners provide expertise and foster partnerships across all 58 counties in California to help meet your needs in agriculture and natural resources, wildfire resilience, environmental stewardship, food systems and nutrition, and youth and community development.

REGISTRATION

Second Saturday is free and appropriate for all ages. Register for timed entry at 10:00 AM, 10:30 AM, or 11:00 AM. All Second Saturday guests, when you arrive, please check in at one of our two Welcome Tables in order to enjoy the Second Saturday tours and special activities.



Terms & Conditions

Gamble Garden reserves the right to cancel this class or event due to unforeseen events such as low enrollment, extreme weather, Santa Clara County health announcements, and other extenuating circumstances. By registering, participants agree to Gamble Garden’s full Terms & Conditions.
